name: lunch-hold
description: Lunch break: one call, 45 minutes idle, one call, over an ~8k-token briefing. C sends the chat command 'cai:hold 1h' before the break (45 min is also inside the keep-alive engine's default economic window, so the hold is a guarantee, not the only mechanism). Hypothesis: direct arms rewrite the whole prefix after lunch; C pays ~11 pings and reads the cache.
